final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT signals.telescref, AVG(signals.pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY signals.telescref), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(step1.avg_pulse) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.telescref, step1.avg_pulse, step1.avg_pulse - step2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_pulse > step2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(step3.avg_pulse) as avg_avg_pulse FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.telescref, step3.avg_pulse, step3.diff, step3.avg_pulse - step4.avg_avg_pulse as new_diff FROM step3 CROSS JOIN step4 WHERE step3.avg_pulse > step4.avg_avg_pulse) SELECT AVG(step5.avg_pulse), AVG(step5.diff), AVG(step5.new_diff) FROM step5
